name: Traction
description: Turns a driven wheel's motor current into acceleration of a chassis: the chassis Velocity changes at Torque constant × current / (Wheel radius × Chassis mass). Connect it from a Motor (it reads the Armature current) to a Chassis mass (it changes the Velocity). Torque constant (N·m/A, default 0.1) is the torque the motor makes for each ampere. Wheel radius (m, default 0.05) turns that torque into a force at the ground. Chassis mass (kg, default 2) turns the force into an acceleration; set it to match the Chassis mass node.
